UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated user account record isolated per user, storing profile metadata, credit balance, and moderation status.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: User display name from Google sign-in.

credits.description: Remaining migration/export credits (starter balance 50; owner can only decrement, admins can adjust).

isBanned.description: Whether the account is suspended from workspace features by an admin.

banReason.description: Optional moderation reason set by an admin.

lastDailyClaimAt.description: Server timestamp of the user's most recent daily free credit claim.

lastPromoCode.description: Most recently redeemed promo code ID.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when account record was last updated.

CreditTransaction.title: CreditTransaction
CreditTransaction.description: Immutable credit spend, daily claim, promo redemption, or admin grant ledger entry for a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the account.

amount.description: Signed credit delta (negative for spend, positive/negative for claims, promos, or admin adjustment).

reason.description: Human-readable description of credit usage or grant.

actorEmail.description: Admin email when created by an admin adjustment.

promoCode.description: Optional promo code identifier for promo redemptions.

SavedMigration.title: SavedMigration
SavedMigration.description: User-saved Minecraft modpack migration snapshot (metadata only, never JAR binaries).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the migration owner.

name.description: User-supplied label for the saved migration.

summary.description: Counts of total, ready, noUpdate, notFound, needsReview, and failed mods.

items.description: Bounded list of migrated mod metadata snapshots (max 300).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when snapshot was saved.

TrackedMod.title: TrackedMod
TrackedMod.description: A Modrinth mod saved to the user's personal mod library for tracking and updates.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the mod library owner.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when mod was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when mod metadata was last updated.

SiteConfig.title: SiteConfig
SiteConfig.description: Global website configuration controlled by verified admins (maintenance mode, news banner, hero copy, loader toggles, credit rules).

maintenanceMode.description: Whether non-admin visitors are redirected to the dedicated maintenance panel.

maintenanceMessage.description: Message displayed on the maintenance panel.

newsEnabled.description: Whether the site-wide news banner is active.

newsTitle.description: Short headline for the announcement banner.

workspaceEnabled.description: Whether authenticated non-admin users can run workspace tasks.

disabledLoaders.description: Optional list of temporarily disabled mod loaders (max 4).

creditsEnabled.description: Whether migration/export credit consumption is enforced for non-admins.

migrationCreditCost.description: Credits deducted per modpack migration analysis (0-50).

libraryCheckCreditCost.description: Credits deducted per bulk library update check (0-50).

updatedBy.description: Verified email of the admin who made the update.

AdminAuditLog.title: AdminAuditLog
AdminAuditLog.description: Immutable admin action log recording site setting changes and moderation actions.

actorEmail.description: Verified admin email performing the action.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp of the log entry.

SharedPack.title: SharedPack
SharedPack.description: Publicly readable shareable modpack list (no user PII stored).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the creator.

authorName.description: Display name shown on the shared pack page (no email/PII).

modCount.description: Total number of mods in the shared pack (1-300).

items.description: Bounded list of mod metadata & Modrinth CDN download links (1-300).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when shared link was created.

code.description: Uppercase promo code matching document ID.

active.description: Whether the promo code is currently active.

note.description: Optional admin label or campaign note.

createdBy.description: Verified admin email that created the code.

PromoRedemption.title: PromoRedemption
PromoRedemption.description: Immutable per-user promo code redemption receipt preventing double-claims.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID matching document ID.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user account profile isolated to the authenticated owner (readable and moderated by verified admins).

/users/{userId}/creditTransactions/{txId.description: Immutable credit ledger for spend receipts, daily claims, promo redemptions, and admin grants.

/users/{userId}/migrations/{migrationId}.description: Private saved migration history snapshots owned by userId (manageable by verified admins).

/users/{userId}/mods/{modId}.description: Private user mod library entries owned by userId (manageable by verified admins).

/sharedPacks/{shareId}.description: Shareable modpack links readable by direct link (get) and listed/managed by owner or admins.

/promoCodes/{codeId}.description: Admin-managed credit promo codes (direct get by verified users, list/create/delete by admins).

/promoCodes/{codeId}/redemptions/{userId.description: Immutable per-user promo redemption lock preventing repeat claims.

/siteConfig/{configId}.description: Global site configuration (doc ID: global) publicly readable and admin-writable.

/siteConfig/{configId}/auditLogs/{logId}.description: Immutable audit log of admin changes.
